title: Efficient multilingual neural machine translation for low resource languages
abstract: We investigate multilingual translation models for languages with limited parallel data and compare transfer strategies across several evaluation settings.

title: Robust semantic segmentation of satellite imagery under domain shift
abstract: We study computer vision methods for segmenting satellite images when sensors and geographic regions differ between training and deployment.

title: Explainable medical image classification with uncertain model predictions
abstract: We explore explanations for medical image classifiers and assess whether visual attributions remain useful when model predictions are uncertain.

title: Safe reinforcement learning for robotic navigation in dynamic environments
abstract: We examine reinforcement learning policies for robotic navigation with moving obstacles and evaluate safety constraints across simulated environments.

title: Multimodal question answering over scientific figures and captions
abstract: We investigate how models combine scientific figure content with accompanying captions to answer technical questions and identify unsupported responses.

title: Retrieval augmented generation for grounded scientific literature summaries
abstract: We study retrieval augmented language generation for scientific summaries and measure whether cited evidence supports generated factual claims.

title: Detecting hallucinated citations in large language model answers
abstract: We examine automatic methods for finding fabricated bibliographic citations in language model answers and compare document verification strategies.

title: Few shot object detection for rare wildlife camera images
abstract: We test object detection methods using small labelled wildlife camera datasets and analyze performance on rare species and changing backgrounds.

title: Fairness evaluation of speech recognition across regional accents
abstract: We analyze speech recognition errors across regional accents and investigate how balanced training data changes performance across speaker groups.

title: Privacy preserving federated learning for hospital patient records
abstract: We examine federated model training across hospitals and evaluate privacy protection alongside predictive accuracy under heterogeneous patient populations.

title: Graph neural networks for predicting molecular properties from structures
abstract: We investigate graph representation methods for molecular property prediction and compare learned chemical features on held out compounds.

title: Continual learning for image classifiers facing new visual categories
abstract: We study image classification systems that learn new categories over time while reducing forgetting of previously observed visual classes.

title: Human interpretable explanations for automated loan decision models
abstract: We compare explanation methods for automated loan decisions and assess whether users can identify model errors from the explanations.

title: Adversarial robustness of vision transformers on noisy street scenes
abstract: We evaluate vision transformers under image perturbations and study how noise affects recognition of objects in street scenes.

title: Energy efficient language models for on device text summarization
abstract: We explore compressed language models for local text summarization and compare output quality with memory use and energy consumption.

title: Deep learning methods for early crop disease detection
abstract: We study visual diagnosis of crop disease from field photographs and evaluate whether models generalize across farms and seasons.

title: Causal representation learning for autonomous driving perception systems
abstract: We investigate learned visual representations for autonomous driving and test whether they remain stable under environmental changes and interventions.

title: Reliable open vocabulary detection in industrial inspection images
abstract: We examine object detection for industrial inspection when defect names are not fixed and evaluate performance on previously unseen categories.

title: Interactive agents that learn from human feedback during planning
abstract: We study agents that adapt planning behavior from human feedback and assess whether learned policies remain safe in new tasks.

title: Cross lingual information retrieval for multilingual research discovery
abstract: We investigate retrieval methods that match scientific questions with papers in different languages and evaluate ranking under limited supervision.
